svg.font-family: 'Geist Mono', ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', monospace
svg.title: itr-agent architecture
svg.desc: itr-agent architecture. 12 components in 4 groups. Connections: You to MCP client; You to incometax.gov.in (you press submit); MCP client to stdio transport (JSON-RPC over stdio); stdio transport to MCP tool surface; MCP tool surface to Tax engine; MCP tool surface to Form picker; MCP tool surface to Interest + HRA; MCP tool surface to Form 26AS; MCP tool surface to AIS; engine to Rule pack (every constant); parsers to Your 26AS / AIS exports (read-only, extension allow-list).

text.tspan: One local Node process over stdio. No network, no telemetry, no accounts.
